evidence.quote: All courses are taught in English.
Applications for this programme are submitted via uni-assist.

notes: Only the DAAD page describes this Bachelor's programme (Marketing and International Business, Hochschule Koblenz); all other supplied pages concern other programmes (MBA, M.A. HRM, Master Business Management) and could not be used. Tuition: the DAAD page gives the programme's own wording 'Tuition fees per semester None' and a semester contribution of 322 EUR; because no figure is stated specifically for a non-EU applicant, no tuition fact is extracted — the human auditor should note that no tuition is charged, only the 322 EUR semester fee. Intakes: application period dates are given without a year, so no dated intakes could be extracted. Application channel: uni-assist is named, but the page does not state that a foreign-diploma applicant must first obtain a VPD (preliminary review document), so de-uni-assist was chosen. Documents: no document list for this programme appears in the supplied texts.

evidence.quote: To be admitted to the English-language Bachelor's programme in Marketing & International Business, you must also provide proof of English language proficiency at level C1 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR).
TOEFL iBT (before 2026): 95 Reading: 24 Listening: 22 Speaking: 25 Writing: 24

note.fr: Le programme a un numerus clausus (NC) : une note minimale ou d'autres critères spéciaux s'appliquent et seuls certains candidats sont retenus lors d'une procédure de sélection.
note.en: The programme has restricted admission: a numerus clausus (minimum grade) or other special criteria apply and only a limited number of applicants are offered a place through a selection process.

evidence.quote: In addition, this programme has restricted admission. This means there is a Numerus clausus (NC, a minimum grade requirement) or other special criteria.

note.fr: Les dates de candidature sont propres au programme : pour l'hiver du 17 mai au 15 juin, pour l'été du 16 novembre au 15 décembre (valables pour les candidats de tous les pays). Vérifiez le portail.
note.en: Application periods are programme-specific: for the winter semester 17 May to 15 June, for the summer semester 16 November to 15 December (valid for applicants from all countries). Check the portal.
